verdict.rationale: ReadMe's own docs cover hosting the hub on your company domain, set up from Configuration > Custom Domain, including CNAME setup, apex versus subdomain choices, and SSL certificates. That satisfies the custom-domain half of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of serving docs as a /docs subpath of the main site (reverse proxy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-domain setup.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I serve docs on my own custom domain or as a /docs subpath of my main site

citations.quote: Hosting docs on your company domain is an important part of making your docs polished and professional. You can setup a custom domain from **Configuration** > **Custom Domain**.
Host your docs on your own domain, covering CNAME setup, apex domains versus subdomains, and SSL certificates.
